title: Street Fighter 6 Game Reveals Yasmine, Arjun, Bosch, Final Fantasy VII's Tifa in Year 4
content: CAPCOM revealed the characters that will be available in Year 4 of its Street Fighter 6 fighting game. The new characters include Yasmine, Arjun, Bosch, and Final Fantasy VII's Tifa. English version Japanese version The game launched in June 2023 for PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam .
author: ANN

title: Square Enix Reveals Final Fantasy VII Revelation Game for Release in Spring 2027
content: Square Enix revealed at the Summer Games Fest event on Friday the Final Fantasy VII Revelation game. The game will launch simultaneously on all platforms ( PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC, Nintendo Switch 2, PC via Steam and Epic Games Store) in spring 2027.
author: ANN

title: Among Us is Now Streaming on Paramount+ In Surprise Release
content: Animated video game adaptations have become big business in Hollywood, with Netflix being a prime example of a streaming service capitalizing on this market. The streaming service has created the likes of Devil May Cry, Castlevania, Splinter Cell, Captain Laserhawk , and Arcane , being just a few examples.
author: ComicBook

title: Monster Hunter Wilds Gets 'Ascendance' Expansion in 2027
content: CAPCOM revealed an expansion for its Monster Hunter Wilds game at the Summer Games Fest event on Friday. The expansion, titled Monster Hunter Wilds Ascendance , will launch in 2027. The Monster Hunter Wilds game debuted globally on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam in February 2025.
author: ANN

title: Stranger Than Heaven Game's Trailer Reveals Tupac, More Cast, January 15 Release
content: Sega unveiled during the Summer Game Fest 2026 livestream on Friday a new trailer for Ryu ga Gotoku Studio's Stranger Than Heaven game (previously codenamed "Project Century"). The video reveals more cast members, including American rapper Tupac, and the January 15 release for Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, and PC…
author: ANN

title: New Virtua Fighter Game Officially Revealed as Virtua Fighter Crossroads in Trailer
content: Sega and its Ryu ga Gotoku Studio formally revealed the Virtua Fighter Crossroads game for a release in 2027 at the Summer Games Fest event on Friday. The companies originally revealed the latest project Sega 's Virtua Fighter 3D fighting game series in December 2024.
author: ANN

title: Platinum Games Announces New Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Last Ronin Game
content: Paramount Games announced during the Summer Game Fest 2026 livestream on Friday that Platinum Games is developing a new game in the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles franchise titled Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Last Ronin .
author: ANN

title: Bandai Namco Announces Gundam: Rogue Orbit Game
content: Bandai Namco announced during the Summer Game Fest 2026 livestream on Friday a new game in the Gundam franchise titled Gundam Rogue Orbit . The game is scheduled to launch for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and PC via Steam in 2027.
author: ANN

title: Resident Evil: Code Veronica Game Gets Remake
content: CAPCOM announced during the Summer Game Fest 2026 livestream on Friday Resident Evil Veronica , a remake, or reimagining, of the 2000 Resident Evil: Code Veronica game, for release on PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam in 2027.
